title: At least 21 killed after Israeli-hit building in Gaza City collapses
summary_or_snippet: Rescue workers say search for dozens of people hampered by lack of heavy machinery A building housing about 100 displaced Palestinian families has collapsed in Gaza City, killing at least 21 people in their sleep, including 11 children, forcing rescuers to dig through the rubble with their bare hands as they search for dozens of people believed to be trapped. A rescue team from Gaza's civil defence said they had recovered the bodies of five children among the victims, while 25 injured people were taken to hospital. Medical sources said rescuers could hear the voices of people trapped beneath the rubble as they tried to reach them.

title: Trump administration denies entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead of UN general assembly
summary_or_snippet: It is the second year this administration has barred the Palestinian delegation from US travel ahead of the forum The US state department said on Wednesday that it had again denied entry visas to Palestinian officials ahead next week's United Nations general assembly gathering in New York . The state department said in a statement that the Palestinian Authority (PA) and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) had "failed to live up to their commitments", accusing the groups of "taking actions to internationalize the Israeli-Palestinian Conflict including through the International Criminal Court (ICC) and International Court of Justice (ICJ)" and of "glorifying terrorism" among other allegations.
